description: Validation results dropped because a filing uses a term proposed in an open urpx-org/urpx pull request. One entry per pull request. An entry drops nothing once the shapes in use name any of its 'defines' terms as an sh:path. A result is dropped only when its sh:resultPath ('path', null at node level) and sh:sourceConstraintComponent match and its focus node passes the named 'focus' test against the data graph without the ontology mixed in. The focus tests are implemented in dev/shacl_gate.clj and dev/validate-with-base.py; dev/test_shacl_gate.clj and dev/test_shape_exceptions.py hold the negatives. Delete an entry once the pinned revisions carry its pull request.
